comments.text: Thanks Eve Maler --- UMA's breakdown of problems + goals still live in the back of my mind! While UMA's "ticket" is like an unsigned permission slip that the client can take to go get approval... SMART's (current) concept is that a "ticket" is the signed authorization artifact presented to obtain an access token. Would love to think about how this pattern could apply broadly (or borrow from other work; we never want to reinvent).

author.name: John Scully
author.headline: Decentralized Medical Records System. Blockchain-based system, US patent 12266430

comments.text: President Trump's vision is to revolutionize our medical records system by simplifying and decentralizing it.   Imagine a future where every citizen truly owns and controls their own medical records. This shift not only empowers individuals but also enhances privacy and security.   Blockchain technology provides the perfect solution for achieving this goal.
